comments.author: Emm Gumar Ang
comments.text:
I support the Philippines' participation in Pax Silica. This could be a major opportunity to accelerate our semiconductor industry and attract high-value foreign investments.

However, attracting billions in investments should not be our only measure of success.

A single semiconductor fabrication plant can stimulate an entire industrial ecosystem—from chemical manufacturers, silica and silicon processors, industrial gas suppliers and water treatment companies to engineering contractors, logistics providers and Filipino SMEs.

The real question is: How much economic value will remain in the Philippines?

I believe the government should secure clear commitments on local supplier development, technology transfer, Filipino workforce development, energy competitiveness, water sustainability, environmental protection, fiscal transparency and SME participation.

Support the investment, but negotiate the economic benefits.

We should use Pax Silica not merely to host foreign factories, but to develop our own industrial capabilities.

Foreign investment is welcome. Philippine economic development must be part of the deal.
